release_slices.plain_english_purpose: Restore the richer POS setup, terminal unlock, and cashier workflow UI from PR #25 while keeping the current production terminal-pairing safety controls.
release_slices.purpose: Adopt the PR #25 POS setup/cashier user experience with matching backend cashier setup, cashier login, and POS Settings PIN APIs without replacing the current production POS terminal-pairing backend.
release_slices.implementation_summary: Selectively restores PR #25 POS terminal UI files, shared POS shell files, setup-flow utilities, and contract tests; adds the missing backend setup-cashier, cashier-login, and POS Settings access-PIN endpoints; preserves existing DGFY tenant context, HttpOnly terminal-pairing cookies, and shift guards; records compliance impact for the major POS/settings change.
included_features: Richer PR #25 POS setup and cashier workspace UI
Cashier username/email login for POS terminal unlock
POS setup cashier list/create APIs backed by existing tenant users
POS Settings access PIN verification and hash-only storage
Shared POS shell and transaction-history pending-sync affordance
Focused contract tests for setup flow, terminal pairing, DGFY admin bypass, cashier settings, session source, and terminal view modes
excluded_features: Replacing the current production terminal-pairing backend with older PR #25 backend code
Production deployment before staging and master reflection
release_slices.regression_warning_summary: This hotfix changes POS terminal setup, cashier login, settings PIN verification, and transaction-history UI; regressions could block POS access, weaken cashier role restrictions, or hide terminal setup requirements.
potentially_affected_existing_behaviors: POS terminal first-run setup and DGFY company selection
Cashier unlock and role-restricted POS login
POS Settings profile, storefront, and POS setup tabs
POS transaction history receipt viewing and pending offline sync display
